I've cross-referenced the accounts with open P1/critical tickets and high churn risk. Here are the accounts that meet both criteria:

### **Accounts with Open P1 Tickets and High Churn Risk**

| Company Name | Customer ID | Churn Risk Score | P1 Ticket Subject | Account Owner |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hearthstone Labs** | CUST-0303 | **0.95** | Salesforce sync failing intermittently / Dashboard load times degraded | Dana Reyes |
| **Hearthstone Co** | CUST-0285 | **0.99** | Column sorting broken on custom dashboard | Lena Fischer |
| **Nimbus Partners** | CUST-0245 | **0.94** | Salesforce sync failing intermittently | Lena Fischer |
| **Vertex Group** | CUST-0131 | **0.95** | Snowflake connector missing rows on incremental sync | Priya Nair |
| **Wavelength Technologies**| CUST-0463 | **0.96** | CSV export encoding incorrect | Lena Fischer |
| **Redwood Labs** | CUST-0009 | **0.91** | Data not refreshing after manual trigger | Omar Haddad |
| **Coppervale Group** | CUST-0042 | **0.92** | API rate limit documentation unclear | Omar Haddad |

### **Analysis & Reasoning**
- **High Churn Risk:** I filtered for accounts with a `churn_risk_score` greater than **0.8**.
- **Open P1 Tickets:** I identified accounts with tickets currently in an "open" status and "critical" priority.
- **Intersection:** The accounts listed above are at significant risk because they are facing major technical blockers (P1 issues) while already showing a high statistical likelihood of churning.

**Strategic Note:** 
Hearthstone Labs (CUST-0303) and Hearthstone Co (CUST-0285) are particularly critical, with risk scores near 1.0 and open issues affecting core dashboard and sync functionality. Immediate outreach from their respective CSMs (Dana Reyes and Lena Fischer) is recommended.

{"query":"FROM ai-index-idx-precision-corpus METADATA _id, _index, _score
| WHERE content:"tickets" OR content:"accounts" OR content:"churn"
| FORK
    ( WHERE content:"P1" OR content:"risk" | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 20 )
    ( WHERE content.semantic:"P1 open tickets" OR content.semantic:"high churn risk accounts" | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 20 )
| FUSE
| SORT _score DESC, _id ASC
| KEEP title, description, content, type, tags
| LIMIT 10"}
